open_issues: Wakeel.Design/Components/WCard.razor: the Neutral variant never renders its `Desc` parameter (only the semantic variants do), so seven admin cards silently lost the line under their title. Outside my allowed paths, so I worked around it by putting a WSectionHeader (Title+Sub) inside those cards. The design package should either render Desc for Neutral or drop the parameter so the next caller is not misled.

Wakeel.Design/Components/WTable.razor.css: the wrapper is `overflow-x:auto` + `max-height:560px; overflow-y:auto`, and WebView2 paints both scroll tracks even for a three-row table that fits. Cosmetic, visible as two thin bars on A06/A07; outside my allowed paths.

A05's structure tree is still hand-rolled (AdminStructureNode) and its per-level indentation is barely visible (about 4px a level), so the four layers do not read as a staircase. This is the known deviation reserved for the shared-WTree design-consistency package; I did not rebuild it.

src/Wakeel.Admin.UI/Pages/A01CreateAccount.razor (admin-1, accepted): the footer hint keeps saying «أكمل الحقول ثم أنشئ الحساب.» after every field is valid and the button has gone live. Low; I left accepted admin-1 work alone rather than touch it after acceptance.

Wakeel.Design ThemeService has three states (System/Light/Dark) but the admin bar is a two-way switch, so there is no way back to «follow this computer» once a choice is made. I fixed the visible half of this (the switch no longer offers dark on a screen that is already dark) inside AdminLayout; offering the third state needs a design decision.

Harness note, not a product defect: the WebView2 remote-debugging endpoint on 9334 closes itself when the window sits idle or occluded for a minute or two, while the WPF process stays healthy. Drive the host in tight batches and restart it when /json/version stops answering.
notes:
HOST RUN — Wakeel.Admin.exe, --remote-debugging-port=9334, --window-size=1366x768, temporary --data-folder; every screenshot taken at exactly 1366x768 (Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride, because the display is at 125% and the raw WebView is 1709px wide). Drove A01 (password + names → recovery sheet with the single 21-character code and QR → «ابدأ») → A03 → A02 on the next start → A04 → A05 (two دوائر, a قسم, a وحدة marked مكتب with code INV-1042) → A06 (three devices: مدير المكتب/كامل, سكرتير/كامل, موظف العُهد/العُهد فقط) → A07 (office key issued, custodian activated, الجهاز ٢ revoked through the typed danger dialog → signed revocation list). Host log clean: seven "host starting up" lines, no WRN/ERR/FTL. Process killed; nothing left running.

WHAT THE RUN ACTUALLY BROKE, AND THE FIX
1. Letter template read twice (real bug, would have shipped). The owner's docx puts its letterhead in three text boxes, and Word writes each one twice — mc:Choice for itself and mc:Fallback for an older Word. The inspector walked every w:p, so six of the nine marks were reported «×٢» and every letterhead line was drawn twice in the A4 preview, in the wrong order. LetterTemplate.cs now skips any paragraph under mc:Fallback and reads headers → body → footers, so the sheet opens with الترويسة and reads like a letter. Regression test added (LetterTemplate_TheLetterheadIsReadOnceEvenThoughWordWritesItTwice: every placeholder count == 1 and no repeated paragraph).
2. Stale organisation line. The bar said «لا دوائر · لا أقسام · لا وحدات» while the A05 tree beside it showed two departments, and only corrected itself when you left the screen. AdminPageHeaderState.Refresh(), AdminLayout re-reading the summary on every header change, A05.Reload() raising it.
3. Appearance switch lied. Until a theme is chosen ThemeService is in System state; AdminLayout treated that as light, so on a dark-preferring computer the button offered «المظهر الداكن» over an already dark screen and the first press changed nothing. Added wakeelAdmin.isDrawnDark() (my own admin.js) and the layout asks the page what it is drawing.
4. Seven cards had lost their subtitle (WCard Neutral ignores Desc) — now WSectionHeader inside the card. That is also what restored the preview's «3 أجهزة في هذا المكتب» line on A06.

PER-SCREEN SIDE BY SIDE (host screenshot vs design/exports/preview/*/A/*.jpg)
A04 «الهيئة والهوية» — same top bar, same seven tabs, same title/sub on the right with actions on the left, same 2×2 card grid (اسم الهيئة | شعار الهيئة, الدورة المالية | صيغة ترقيم الملفات) and the report-template card full width below.
· card subtitles missing → FIXED (WSectionHeader).
· «حفظ» / «الشعار» / «صيغة الترقيم» / «قالب التقرير الشهري» / «يوم بداية الدورة» → FIXED to «حفظ التغييرات» / «شعار الهيئة» / «صيغة ترقيم الملفات» / «قالب التقرير الشهري (اختياري)» / «يوم بداية الدورة المالية (١–٢٨)».
· preview keeps the item-5 caution visible in the numbering card; the host only showed it after an edit → FIXED, the amber line is always in the card and the full warning still gates the change in its dialog.
· preview's revert button is «استعادة الافتراضي» → ACCEPTED as «التراجع عن التعديلات»: the button puts the form back to what was saved, which is not the same thing as restoring defaults (that is the separate «العودة إلى الصيغة الافتراضية» inside the numbering card).
· preview says the logo may be PNG or SVG → ACCEPTED as PNG/JPG: the spec requires a square crop of a raster image.
· the letter-template card (item 57, nine marks + A4/A5 sheet) is not in the preview at all → ACCEPTED, the specification adds it.
A05 «الهيكلية» — same two panes (tree right, detail left), same level chips, head name on the far side of each row, same detail actions with حذف in danger red at the far left.
· tree is hand-rolled and almost unindented → KNOWN, left for the shared-WTree package (recorded, not rebuilt).
· detail form was ragged (one field, then a pair, then one field, half the card empty on two rows) while the preview fills every row → FIXED: all four fields now sit two to a row (the design's field width is a fixed 260px, so two is the honest maximum for this card; the preview fits three because its fields are narrower).
· the parent chooser showed the whole path and cut it mid-word inside the field → FIXED: it shows the parent's name, as the preview does, and the full path is spelled out in the line under it.
· preview title «الهيكلية التنظيمية» and a header «نقل وحدة» button → ACCEPTED: the tab and the spec both say «الهيكلية», and moving is done in the detail pane's التبعية chooser.
· preview's «التحقق من صحة الهيكل» panel → ACCEPTED, not in the specification.
A06 «المكاتب والأجهزة» — same two columns, same office head with the inventory-code chip on the far side, same devices table below.
· list pane and office head were hand-rolled cards (surface + border + radius in page CSS) → FIXED, both are WCard, the head using WSectionHeader with the chips as its ActionContent.
· the 4fr/8fr grid gave the list a third of the page and the devices table had to scroll sideways with every cell wrapping → FIXED, 300px + rest (the preview's list measures ~300px at 1366). Rows now sit on one line.
· «المكاتب» carried the bare word «مكتب» as its count → FIXED to «مكتب في الهيكلية» / «مكتبان …» / «٣ مكاتب …».
· preview has «إضافة مكتب» and «طباعة رمز الجرد» in the header and a «الحاسوب» column → ACCEPTED: an office is created by marking a unit in A05, and the computer's name is not known until the device is set up.
· preview has no إجراءات column; the host adds edit/remove → ACCEPTED, the spec asks for both.
A07 «الحسابات والمفاتيح» — same arrangement (accounts table in the wide column, office key and revocation list stacked in the narrow one), same status chips, same «تدوير مفتاح المكتب» with the "every device needs a new setup file" warning and the count.
· 8fr/4fr squeezed the table until every cell wrapped and it still scrolled sideways → FIXED, rest + 360px.
· revoke dialog matches the preview's anatomy: title, consequences, three key/value rows, an amber "what remains" line, a typed confirmation, «إلغاء الجهاز» in danger beside «العودة». The host asks the person to type «تأكيد» where the preview types «إلغاء الجهاز» → ACCEPTED, one confirmation word is used by every danger dialog in the tool.
· preview's «مفاتيح الأجهزة» fingerprint card → ACCEPTED: the host shows the same fact as the seed state inside the accounts table («بذرة المفتاح محفوظة…» / «غادرت بذرة المفتاح الأداة مع ملف الإعداد»), which is what the spec asks for.
A01/A02/A03 (admin-1, driven end to end): one 21-character recovery code plus QR, no «تذكر هذا الجهاز», A03 counts live off the tables and the two switched-off controls carry their visible reason — all as ruled.

MEASUREMENTS: viewport 1366×768 for every shot. Design field width is a fixed 260px (.w-field), which is what decides two-per-row on A05. A06 grid 300px + 1054px; A07 grid 1fr + 360px. Both themes checked on all four screens; the top bar stays dark in light mode by design. Names and file names that a person types are isolated for bidi — where a design component draws them as plain text (WSectionHeader/WCard titles) the page CSS sets unicode-bidi: plaintext via ::deep, since those components take strings, not fragments.
